name: Economic incentive — IV1-body
text:
Fᵢ = 1: full reimbursement

Bᵢ = 1: reimbursement + bonus

Reference: participant charge (Fᵢ = Bᵢ = 0)

name: Actual AI capability — IV2-body
text:
Qᵢ = 1: high-capability AI

Qᵢ = 0: low-capability AI

Capability is defined by objective task-specific accuracy.
